behavior: Every adopting repository calls the shared workflow pinned by full SHA.
verification: for r in garsync hive iris kubelab leaving-denver mail2markdown pdf-modifier pollex svqtriana.github.io ts-bridge web yt-metrics-cli; do gh api repos/mlorentedev/$r/contents/.github/workflows/pr-agent.yml --jq .content | base64 -d | grep -qE 'ci-workflows/.github/workflows/pr-agent.yml@[0-9a-f]{40}' || echo $r; done | (! grep .)

behavior: No adopter keeps a copy of the review steps.
verification: for r in garsync hive iris kubelab leaving-denver mail2markdown pdf-modifier pollex svqtriana.github.io ts-bridge web yt-metrics-cli; do files=$(gh api repos/mlorentedev/$r/contents/.github/workflows --jq '.[].path') || { echo "$r: list failed"; continue; }; for p in $files; do c=$(gh api repos/mlorentedev/$r/contents/$p --jq .content) || { echo "$r: $p read failed"; continue; }; base64 -d <<<"$c" | grep -q 'The-PR-Agent/pr-agent' && echo "$r: $p"; done; done | (! grep .)

behavior: Each adopter's .pr_agent.toml holds only what differs from the base plus the shared class paragraph, and a test holds it against the adopter's own classification registry.
verification: for r in garsync hive iris kubelab leaving-denver mail2markdown pdf-modifier pollex svqtriana.github.io ts-bridge web yt-metrics-cli; do jq -e '.classification.prefix == "Class: " and .classification.classes == ["REAL","THEORETICAL","SPECULATIVE"] and .classification.reviewers == ["github-actions"]' <(gh api repos/mlorentedev/$r/contents/harness/review-attestation.json --jq .content | base64 -d) >/dev/null || { echo "$r: registry"; continue; }; ins=$(gh api repos/mlorentedev/$r/contents/.pr_agent.toml --jq .content | base64 -d | yq -p toml -oy '.pr_reviewer.extra_instructions // ""'); for c in REAL THEORETICAL SPECULATIVE; do grep -qF "\"Class: $c\"" <<<"$ins" || echo "$r: instructions lack $c"; done; bats=$(gh api "repos/mlorentedev/$r/git/trees/HEAD?recursive=1" --jq '.tree[].path | select(endswith(".bats"))') || { echo "$r: tree failed"; continue; }; found=0; for p in $bats; do c=$(gh api repos/mlorentedev/$r/contents/$p --jq .content) || { echo "$r: $p read failed"; continue; }; base64 -d <<<"$c" | grep -qE '^@test "the instructions ask for exactly the classes the registry reads" \{' && found=1; done; [ "$found" = 1 ] || echo "$r: no registry test"; done | (! grep .)

behavior: Every adopter PR gets a PR-Agent review from the shared workflow, and no batch loses a review to NaN's slot limit.
verification: for r in garsync hive iris kubelab leaving-denver mail2markdown pdf-modifier pollex svqtriana.github.io ts-bridge web yt-metrics-cli; do n=$(gh pr list --repo mlorentedev/$r --head chore/adopt-shared-pr-agent --state all --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty') || { echo "$r: list failed"; continue; }; [ -n "$n" ] || { echo "$r: no adopter PR"; continue; }; k=$(gh api --paginate repos/mlorentedev/$r/issues/$n/comments --jq '.[] | select(.user.login == "github-actions[bot]" and (.body | test("PR Reviewer Guide"))) | .id') || { echo "$r#$n: comments failed"; continue; }; [ -n "$k" ] || echo "$r#$n: no review"; done | (! grep .)
